title: Explicit contravariant Verdier functor on common-stage representatives
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with field k and characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated finite-type scheme X over k. Use the actual raw rational finite stages, scalar extensions, tensor comparisons and common-stage pair category of [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]. For Finite F satisfying FiniteCoherent, the explicit descendedDual sends a finite object (E,K) to (E,D_E K). There is a natural inclusion comparison descendedComparison whose components are heterogeneously equal to identity maps. All functors are actual quotient constructions, with no existence-chosen functor data.

source.place: Final coefficient-transport paragraph; core descent retained steps 1--5 and formal retract restriction step 10

proof.text: Build a StageSystem morphism from the opposite stages with finite functors D_E and beta. The tower equation is the morphism coherence axiom after canceling the inverse opposite associator.

The published stage system equals the literal transition system by its uniqueness characterization. Transport the morphism along this equality and compose its quotient functor with reversal of representatives. The inclusion comparison is the identity on components and is natural by functor_map_ι.
